name: code-skeptic-scanner-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end layer for Code Skeptic Scanner, driven by its own self-contained Vite harness. Every script names a local binary; none is resolved through npx, which would fall back to the registry when the local one is absent. No script downloads a browser: Playwright 1.44.1's downloader does not verify the TLS chain of the host it fetches from (CVE-2025-59288), so browsers are provisioned out of band from a channel that signs its artifacts. Two fail-closed gates read that provision without fetching, and both exit non-zero when no launchable Chromium is present. browsers:require is the gate: it resolves from PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE, then CHROME_BIN, then the platform's vendor install locations, then the exact path chromium.executablePath() reports for this pin - the only correct source for that route, because Playwright loads the build matching its own pinned revision and is the only thing that knows where PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH points, including the value 0. It records the resolved build's version, publishes the executable through GITHUB_ENV so the path launched is provably the path logged, and accepts an optional --min-major floor. browsers:verify is the narrower reporter over the same two filesystem locations - the explicit executable and the cache path - searching no vendor location and publishing nothing. test:list overrides the reporter so listing cannot overwrite a previous run's JUnit and HTML reports with an all-skipped stub. See docs/testing/DECISION-LOG.md rows D111, D129, D236, D252 and D264, the last superseded by D300.
